messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — genqueue latency spike in US-West. 5xx rate up ~3% over baseline, error budget approaching threshold.
emily_oncall: I'm on it. I have access, will triage. @matt_prod can you grab traces? :eyes:
matt_prod: looking at traces now, seeing a spike in genqueue CPU and thundering small requests. attaching quick link: https://obs.redwood/graph/abc123
observability-bot: Snapshot: cpu: 92% -> https://obs.redwood/snap/1778881234
sara_ops: tagging ops-runbook, we should prepare a status page. who is drafting initial copy? I'll handle customer impact estimate.
emily_oncall: I'll draft initial statuspage text. Aiming for a short initial notice stating we are investigating and impacted endpoints.
matt_prod: note — model fallback is working for some customers; want to include mitigation note about automatic fallbacks where active.
emily_oncall: draft (copy):
```
Initial update (investigating): We are investigating increased latency and elevated error rates affecting generation endpoints in the US-West region. Some requests are experiencing delays or 5xx errors. Engineers are actively triaging; we will post updates every 15 minutes. No data loss has been detected.
```
legal-svc: quick legal check — avoid suggesting SLAs are impacted unless measured. Also remove internal debug links from public copy.
emily_oncall: ack — removing internal links. matt_prod, can you confirm if 'some customers' is safe vs 'some requests'? prefer 'some requests'.
matt_prod: confirmed: say 'some requests' — not customer-wide. Also include fallback note: 'In some cases, automatic model fallbacks may reduce errors.'
emily_oncall: updated draft:
```
Initial update (investigating): We are investigating increased latency and elevated error rates affecting generation endpoints in the US-West region. Some requests are experiencing delays or 5xx errors. In some cases, automatic model fallbacks may reduce errors. Engineers are actively triaging; we will post updates every 15 minutes. No data loss has been detected.
```
sara_ops: impact estimate: ~8% of requests in USW impacted, subset using large-context routes. Adding customer note about degraded performance for high-concurrency workloads.
emily_oncall: final check before publish — approved by ops (sara_ops) and legal (legal-svc)?
legal-svc: approve with one small edit: change 'No data loss has been detected' -> 'We have no evidence of data loss at this time.'
emily_oncall: published initial status page update: https://status.redwood/incident/1778881234 :white_check_mark:
matt_prod: continuing triage — trying rolling restart of genqueue workers now.
emily_oncall: 15m update (post-publish):
```
Update (15 minutes): We have identified elevated CPU contention on genqueue worker pools causing increased latency. Engineers are performing controlled restarts and monitoring results. Error rates have decreased slightly but remain above baseline. Next update in 15 minutes.
```
observability-bot: New graph snapshot: https://obs.redwood/snap/1778881300 cpu trending down to 70%
sara_ops: ops note: restarting 10% of workers succeeded; error rate reduced to ~2%. continuing rollouts.
legal-svc: okay to keep public cadence 15m until stable.
emily_oncall: 45m update:
```
Update (45 minutes): Controlled restarts of genqueue workers have reduced error rates further. We are seeing improvement across most routes; some high-concurrency workloads may still experience degraded performance. Engineers will continue to monitor and validate mitigation. No evidence of data loss.
```
matt_prod: mitigation validation: running load tests, tail latency below SLO for 90% of cases.
emily_oncall: planning resolved notice once metrics are stable for two consecutive 5-minute intervals. posting resolve ETA target in 20 minutes.
sara_ops: note for postmortem: capture root cause: scheduling burst under specific client pattern + worker restart gap. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre.
emily_oncall: resolved notice published: https://status.redwood/incident/1778881234/resolved :tada:
```
Resolved: The incident affecting generation endpoints in US-West has been resolved. Error rates and latency have returned to normal. We have no evidence of data loss at this time. Engineers will follow up with a root cause analysis and postmortem.
```
matt_prod: thanks team — will start postmortem notes and assign action items.
sara_ops: filing customer outreach template for affected accounts.
emily_oncall: closing thread here, will reopen if any regression. :thumbsup:
